review.instruction: Compare the rendered surface with supplied behavior, content, states and acceptance criteria. Reject invented claims, missing actions and behavior inferred without authority.

Inspect actual baseline and result pixels together. For extend or revise, preserve the selected shell, navigation, palette, typography and unchanged regions; reject an unrelated redesign or a candidate based only on filename or memory.
Inspect source and rendered output against the bound UI system and application-owned value inventory. Reject private anatomy selectors, invented tokens and edits to shared authority.

Inspect every declared viewport and required state for hierarchy, readability, overflow, accessibility, interaction and visual quality. Source intent and a synthetic fixture do not prove rendered acceptance.
Inspect the actual diff and commit. Require every changed path inside the mutable owner ceiling and outside protected paths, with no publish, merge or runtime reconfiguration.

failurePolicy: Produce, render, inspect and provide concrete findings. Repair only the failed source region or asset, rerender affected viewports and reassess. Delete rejected image deliverables while keeping concise failure metadata and accepted outputs.
